body:
There's a couple of ways we could do this:

1. We could make a minimal GDExtension (maybe directly in C?) that attempts to load all methods in the `extension_api.json` from the previous minor version and see if any of them fails to load. This feels like the most complete way to test it, because it's not just testing the JSON data, but also the fallback code
2. We could extend the validation we've already got to check for missing methods on the ancestor classes. This would address this specific situation where a method moves up to a parent class. It seems like this would be easier to implement than nr 1, but would be less complete, because there may be some other tricky case we aren't accounting for (either now or in the future)
